LCOM-SRC.description: Load Combination Auto Generation - SRC (LCOM-SRC). DGNCODE selects the active generation payload: 'KDS 41 SRC : 2022' consumes all generation knobs (scale factors, wind, orthogonal, additional and underground loads), while 'AIK-SRC2K' consumes only RS_SCALE_FACTOR. Every generation knob is optional for both codes; an absent knob behaves as unchecked / disabled. The request body is wrapped in 'Argument'.

Argument.description: SRC auto load-combination request. DGNCODE and OPTION are always required; the remaining fields are the flattened generation knobs (the internal INPUTS group is flattened into the top level by DGNCODE).

DGNCODE.description: Design code selecting the active generation payload (case-insensitive). 'KDS 41 SRC : 2022' enables the full knob set; 'AIK-SRC2K' uses only RS_SCALE_FACTOR.

OPTION.description: Add or Replace existing combinations (case-insensitive). Code-agnostic (applies to both DGNCODE variants). ADD (0) appends to existing combinations; REPLACE (1) wipes this design type's combinations then regenerates.

RS_SCALE_FACTOR.description: Response Spectrum Scale Factor rows (applies to both DGNCODE variants). Optional; absent means no scale-up rows. Each row's LOAD_CASE must resolve to a spectrum (SPLC) load case and FACTOR must be in [0, 10].

LOAD_CASE.description: Response Spectrum Load Case name (must resolve to an existing spectrum load case).

WIND_LOAD_COMB.description: [DGNCODE='KDS 41 SRC : 2022'] Wind Load Combination Set. Optional; an absent or empty (PARAMETERS empty) value leaves the wind record untouched.

PARAMETERS.description: List of wind load combination sets.

items.description: One wind load combination set. BUILDING_TYPE decides which wind load cases and factors are needed: MIDDLE requires ALONG (TORSION not used); HIGH requires ALONG plus GUST_FACTOR and KAPPA_FACTOR.

BUILDING_TYPE.description: Wind Loads Group (case-insensitive). MIDDLE = mid-rise; HIGH = high-rise dynamic wind (uses GUST_FACTOR / KAPPA_FACTOR).

WIND_LOAD_CASE.description: Wind Load Cases. ALONG is required by the handler based on BUILDING_TYPE; ACROSS / TORSION reference the WA / WT load cases generated when Across / Torsional wind is enabled.

ACROSS.description: Across Wind Load Case name (WA load case).

TORSION.description: Torsional Wind Load Case name (WT load case).

GUST_FACTOR.description: [BUILDING_TYPE='HIGH'] Gust factor GD (required only for high-rise dynamic wind).

KAPPA_FACTOR.description: [BUILDING_TYPE='HIGH'] Kappa factor (required only for high-rise dynamic wind).

ORTHO_EFFECT.description: [DGNCODE='KDS 41 SRC : 2022'] Orthogonal Effect. Optional; absent or OPT_USE=false disables the effect (an empty record is written). When OPT_USE=true, TYPE and LOAD_GROUP become required and LOAD_GROUP must contain exactly 2 distinct load cases of the same load-case type.

TYPE.description: [OPT_USE=true] Orthogonal Effect Type (case-insensitive). '100_30' = 100:30 combination; 'SRSS' = square root of sum of squares.

LOAD_GROUP.description: [OPT_USE=true] Load Case1, Load Case2. Exactly 2 entries, distinct, of the same load-case type (no ST/RS mixing).

ADDITIONAL_LOAD.description: [DGNCODE='KDS 41 SRC : 2022'] Additional Load. Optional; each half (SPECIAL_LOAD / VERTICAL_LOAD) can be omitted, which is treated as OPT_USE=false. If neither half is enabled, any prior record is cleared.

SPECIAL_LOAD.description: Special Seismic Load. When OPT_USE=true, VERTICAL_LOAD_FACTOR (>0), SDS and OVER_STRENGTH_FACTOR are required.

OPT_USE.description: Whether to apply the special seismic load.

OVER_STRENGTH_FACTOR.description: [OPT_USE=true] Over-strength factors. Each row's LOAD_CASE must resolve to a static or spectrum load case; FACTOR must be > 0.

VERTICAL_LOAD.description: Vertical Seismic Load. When OPT_USE=true, FORCE_FACTOR (>0) is required.

OPT_USE.description: Whether to apply the vertical seismic force.

UNDERGROUND_LOAD.description: [DGNCODE='KDS 41 SRC : 2022'] Underground Load. Optional; absent or OPT_USE=false clears both underground stores. When OPT_USE=true, SCALE_FACTOR and LOAD_CASE_LIST are required.

SCALE_FACTOR.description: [OPT_USE=true] Underground scale factors. Each row's LOAD_CASE must resolve to a valid underground load case; FACTOR must be in [0, 10].

LOAD_CASE_LIST.description: [OPT_USE=true] Underground load case list; must contain at least one entry. Each (LoadCase, Direction) pair must be unique.

LOAD_CASE.description: Seismic Load Case List - LoadCase name.

LOAD_CASE_SEISMIC.description: Earth Pressure Load Case - Seismic. Each name must resolve to a static load case of type EEP.

LOAD_CASE_STATIC.description: Earth Pressure Load Case - Static. Each name must resolve to a static load case of type EH.

SPECIAL_LOAD.description: Underground special load. Optional even when OPT_USE=true. When its own OPT_USE=true, VERTICAL_LOAD_FACTOR (>0), SDS and OVER_STRENGTH_FACTOR are required.

OPT_USE.description: Whether to use special load for underground load.

OVER_STRENGTH_FACTOR.description: [OPT_USE=true] Over-strength factors for underground special load. Each row's LOAD_CASE resolves STLD-first with {E,EVT,EE} fallback to SPLC; FACTOR must be > 0; (LoadCase, Type) pairs must be unique.

items.description: One underground special over-strength factor row.
